title: Alaior Night Market
description: In summer, Alaior brings its streets to life with a night market on Wednesday evenings (roughly 19:00 to 23:00), with crafts, local produce and a village atmosphere. It runs from June to September. Exact 2026 dates to be confirmed with Alaior town council.
imageAlt: A narrow street in Alaior with whitewashed façades at dusk
